new_material_confound.finding: Label-free and lexically disjoint class families are still insufficient if AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL examples come from different scenario/domain families. Global class centroids can then encode scenario-family/domain/style differences rather than the requested semantic state.
why_the_current_rank_test_is_vulnerable: For three global class centroids, centered rank is at most two by construction; observing a second singular component does not identify its cause.
If scenario families are not matched across semantic targets, class identity is partially or fully aliased with scenario/domain identity.
A class-assignment permutation null that ignores scenario blocks can destroy both semantic and scenario structure and therefore produce an anti-conservative null for semantic rank.
A stable intervention can still exploit a reproducible scenario-family axis and appear class-selective on similarly constructed evaluation data.
new_material_confound.counterhypothesis: The apparent one- or two-dimensional semantic control geometry is primarily a matched-dataset construction artifact: topic, phrasing, entailment form, response prior or scenario family creates the dominant latent directions, while true semantic state contributes little or no reusable causal signal.
new_material_confound.falsifier: After within-scenario matched triplet construction, within-family centering, blocked permutation, fresh family holdout and independently rotated output-code mappings, a stable class-selective one- or two-dimensional intervention subspace remains and nuisance controls do not reproduce it.

external_primary_inputs.source: Panickssery et al. (2023/2024), Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: CAA constructs steering vectors from averaged residual-stream differences between paired positive and negative examples.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_implication: Prefer matched within-scenario semantic contrasts over unrelated class centroids so shared scenario content cancels before estimating a direction.

external_primary_inputs.source: Tan et al. (2024), Analyzing the Generalization and Reliability of Steering Vectors
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: Reports substantial in-distribution variability, spurious biases and prompt-change brittleness for steering vectors.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_implication: Scenario/domain and prompt-family variation must be treated as a blocking/generalization factor rather than pooled away.

external_primary_inputs.source: Braun et al. (2025), Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: Reports that higher cosine coherence among training activation differences predicts more effective steering and that effect direction can vary across samples.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_implication: Measure coherence of within-family semantic contrasts and preserve per-family signs instead of relying only on pooled global means.

external_primary_inputs.source: Wu, Zhao, Chen (2026), When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real?
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: Shows steering conclusions can change with activation scaling, readout metric and operating point; residual-norm-comparable intervention and held-out operating-point selection materially change interpretation.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_implication: Keep residual-norm calibration and frozen calibration-only operating-point selection in the blocked successor.

external_primary_inputs.source: Belrose et al. (2023), LEACE: Perfect linear concept erasure in closed form
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: Provides a closed-form way to remove a linearly decodable nuisance concept while minimizing representation change under its stated objective.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_implication: Optional diagnostic only: estimate a code/label nuisance subspace on calibration data and test whether semantic effects survive nuisance erasure; erasure itself does not prove semantics.

successor_discriminator.name: MATCHED_TRIPLET_BLOCKED_SEMANTIC_SIMPLEX_NATIVE_CVEC/v1
phase_0_freeze: Pin exact Qwen3-0.6B source checkpoint/tokenizer, exact GGUF, llama.cpp commit/build, native harness and layer/site identity.
Freeze token-scope conditions and residual-norm-relative gain selection on calibration only.
Freeze semantic target definitions, output-code rotation schedule, primary metric, rank threshold, coherence threshold and off-target drift threshold before opening holdout.

phase_1_matched_triplet_dataset.requirement: Every scenario family supplies AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL variants derived from the same underlying content skeleton, with target identity stored in metadata rather than exposed as pole labels.
controls: Keep entities, topic/domain, approximate length, syntactic template and response format as matched as possible across the three target variants.
Rotate lexical realizations independently across scenario families so no single phrase or synonym becomes the semantic key.
Use independently rotated A/B/C output-code mappings inside each semantic triplet.
phase_1_matched_triplet_dataset.negative_example: Do not build AFFIRMATIVE from one topic family, NEGATIVE from another and NEUTRAL from a third, even if all are label-free.

phase_2_within_family_representation_geo.family_centering: For family f with activations h_fA,h_fN,h_fU, compute m_f=(h_fA+h_fN+h_fU)/3 and d_fC=h_fC-m_f. Global topic/style offsets cancel before semantic rank estimation.
phase_2_within_family_representation_geo.aggregation: Estimate cross-family directions with equal family weighting; report raw and unit-normalized family contrasts so high-norm families cannot silently dominate.
phase_2_within_family_representation_geo.coherence: Report leave-one-family-out cosine/principal-angle stability and the distribution of family-specific signed effects, not only the pooled direction.
phase_2_within_family_representation_geo.rank_test: Estimate one-vs-two-dimensional semantic rank from the stacked within-family centered contrasts. Use a permutation null that permutes semantic labels only within each scenario family and preserves family membership, code mapping and split identity.
phase_2_within_family_representation_geo.holdout_transfer: Fit the candidate subspace on basis/calibration families only, then measure held-out projection energy, principal angles and class-selective causal effects on unopened scenario families.

phase_3_blocked_native_causal_matrix.matrix: Within each holdout scenario family, D_f[i,j] is the mapped-target logit-margin change for requested semantic class j under intervention i minus its matched baseline. Aggregate D with equal family weights.
phase_3_blocked_native_causal_matrix.primary_positive_pattern: Class direction i produces a preregistered diagonal/selective advantage for class i across held-out scenario families; SIGN_FLIP reverses the selective pattern; null/orthogonal/permuted/label-only nuisance controls do not reproduce it.
phase_3_blocked_native_causal_matrix.generic_compliance_rejection: Broad positive uplift across all requested classes, or uplift tied to output-code identity rather than semantic target, rejects semantic specificity.
phase_3_blocked_native_causal_matrix.family_confound_rejection: An effect that disappears after within-family matching/centering or is carried by one scenario family is classified as scenario-family confounding, not J-Space semantic control.

phase_4_scope_and_measurement: Compare PyTorch LAST_TOKEN_ONLY, PyTorch ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS and native llama.cpp ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS_CVEC without calling them strict replications unless intervention scope matches.
Express intervention magnitude relative to local residual norm at the intervention site and freeze the operating point on calibration only.
Keep output readout, scenario-family construction, codebook mapping and threshold selection sealed from holdout.
phase_5_optional_nuisance_erasure_diagno: On calibration only, estimate a linear nuisance subspace for output-code/label-form or other declared nuisance factors.
Apply an exactly documented orthogonalization/LEACE-style diagnostic to ask whether class-selective effects survive nuisance removal.
Treat survival as robustness evidence only; nuisance erasure cannot mint semantic truth and can itself remove entangled true signal.

must_pass: Matched semantic triplets exist within every scenario family in calibration and holdout.
Semantic-label permutation null is blocked within scenario family.
Output-code mapping is independently counterbalanced within semantic targets and scenario families.
At least one candidate semantic dimension exceeds the blocked null and transfers to fresh families.
A second dimension is promoted only if it independently exceeds the blocked null and improves held-out class-selective causal fit.
Per-family causal signs/coherence satisfy preregistered thresholds rather than only pooled significance.
Native causal matrix shows target-specific selectivity under matched baseline subtraction.
SIGN_FLIP and same-norm nuisance controls behave as preregistered.
Residual-norm and operating-point calibration are frozen before holdout.
fail_closed_cases: Only global class centroids are reported without within-family matched contrasts.
Semantic classes are aliased with scenario/domain families.
Rank-2 geometry is observed but causal rank does not transfer to holdout.
Effect exists only for one family or one lexical realization.
Generic requested-code uplift explains the result.
Token-scope mismatch is presented as strict replication.
Gain or threshold is selected after holdout inspection.

information_gain_assessment.why_high_value: This discriminator can simultaneously distinguish true semantic geometry from scenario/domain confounding, determine whether one or two semantic dimensions are warranted, and convert pooled steering success into a family-generalizing causal claim.
information_gain_assessment.why_cheaper_than_new_model_work: It reuses the already pinned Qwen3-0.6B/native cvec lane and changes experimental design/analysis before any new paid training or provider execution.

expected_outcomes.rank1_survives: Retain a one-dimensional semantic control model at bounded component scope.
expected_outcomes.rank2_survives: Promote only a two-dimensional semantic subspace hypothesis at bounded component scope, still not canonical semantics.
expected_outcomes.geometry_survives_but_causality_fails: Representation structure is correlational/noncausal at the tested site.
expected_outcomes.effect_collapses_after_blocking: Previous semantic signal was materially scenario-family/dataset confounded.
expected_outcomes.family_specific_only: Treat as brittle local control, not reusable Global J-Space semantic geometry.

unusual_experiment.reason: This standalone research trigger exposes no canonical shared immutable macrocycle/request identity and no successful create-only atomic lease. Web/source research and durable protocol fusion are ordinary non-intervention work.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 1 identified a second-order confound not closed by label-free lexical deconfounding alone: semantic target can remain aliased with scenario/domain family. The successor design therefore upgrades the semantic-simplex test to matched within-scenario triplets, family centering, within-family blocked permutation, equal-family weighting and held-out causal-matrix transfer. This prevents a rank-1/rank-2 scenario manifold from being misreported as reusable semantic J-Space geometry.
next_exact_action: Implement candidate/regression schema support for matched scenario triplets and blocked semantic-rank evidence before the next native cvec promotion attempt; execute the intervention only after canonical unusual-experiment lease coordination is available.
